paper_title: X-Ray Constraints on Dark Photon Tridents
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, plotted directly on y-axis
notes: Paper constrains dark photon dark matter kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass via three-photon (trident) decay observed with 16 yr INTEGRAL/SPI data, masses 61-1022 keV. Only endpoint values available from text ('from 10^-12 down to 10^-19'); exact exclusion curve (Fig. 4 blue line) not tabulated in the paper text. Endpoints emitted as a two-point approximation. Assumes dark photon is 100% of DM, NFW profile, rho_sun=0.42 GeV/cm^3. Constraint improves with mass due to m^9 decay-width scaling. Paper's primary lifetime limit (Fig. 1) is mapped to epsilon via one-loop amplitude. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 24)) | Vision: Figure 4: ε vs m_A' [keV]. Blue INTEGRAL region is the new constraint from 16 yr INTEGRAL/SPI data via dark photon trident (A'->3γ). Excluded region is above the blue boundary. Boundary traced is approximately a straight power-law line on log-log from ~(60 keV, 1e-12) to ~(1000 keV, 1e-19), consistent with ε∝m^-5.7 and the text statement that the constraint reaches from 10^-12 down to 10^-19 over 61-1022 keV. Other lines (magenta Redondo/Arias EH & loop, gray Xenon/LZ, green stellar bounds) are pre-existing constraints not traced. Full one-loop amplitude used. 95% C.L. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=1.00 snapped to identity)
